svg.title: Experimental loss: six worlds searched, danger underweighted
svg.desc: Before Black Kf4f3, White Ke2 is hidden from Black. The destination f3 is visibly empty but attacked by the unseen king. Black moves there and loses despite a nine-point material lead.
svg.text: Experimental loss: six worlds searched, danger underweighted
Light circles: White pieces · Dark circles: Black pieces · ? hidden · Solid: actual move · Dotted: attacker line when visible
